query:
When the group pivoted from a Peak District hike to an escape room, which member's response to that change most clearly signals they would not have chosen the escape room themselves, and what in their phrasing gives this away?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Theo
C. Zara
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Zara, episodic, t10 @2026-02-12T19:55:00) Tarkovsky retrospective. I would have gone to that. You should have said.
[2] (about=Zara, episodic, t4 @2026-01-22T19:50:00) I would have left. That is not a judgment, it is just what I would have done.
[3] (about=Theo, episodic, t6 @2026-01-29T19:53:00) I'll do the hike with whoever wants to hike. doesn't have to be a group thing.
[4] (about=Seb, episodic, t6 @2026-01-29T19:52:00) yes!! I've been wanting to do an escape room for ages 🙌
[5] (about=Seb, episodic, t10 @2026-02-12T19:47:00) knee is about 70% honestly tho, but I can do an escape room standing around, it's not a hike
[6] (about=Theo, episodic, t14 @2026-02-26T19:40:00) we met because Marcus accidentally walked into the wrong A&E bay and Nadia was the one who had to redirect him. you're right, camping is conservative
[7] (about=Nadia, episodic, t2 @2026-01-15T19:41:00) That house. Zara had a full-length coat she refused to take off inside for three days.
[8] (about=Seb, episodic, t9 @2026-02-12T19:40:00) lads who's sorting the escape room booking for Saturday
[9] (about=Seb, episodic, t11 @2026-02-19T19:55:00) lads I'm still thinking about the escape room
[10] (about=Theo, episodic, t14 @2026-02-26T19:43:00) Nadia and Marcus were the nucleus. Zara and I joined later through the shared house. Seb through you, basically.
agent_answer:
B. Theo

His phrasing — *“I’ll do the hike with whoever wants to hike. doesn’t have to be a group thing”* — signals he was still committed to the original Peak District hike and was not choosing the escape room himself. He frames the escape room as a separate, optional group activity, clearly showing the pivot wasn’t his preference.
